info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Party Reference Data API
info.description: The Update Party Reference Data API allows businesses to manage and modify critical reference data related to parties within their customer management systems. Through this API, users can update existing party records, ensuring that data remains accurate and relevant. Typical consumers include banking and financial institutions that rely on accurate customer information for compliance and operational efficiency. This service aids in maintaining consistency across customer interactions by providing updated reference data for various applications.

put.description: This operation allows you to update the party reference data in the directory, ensuring that the information is accurate and up-to-date. This is crucial for maintaining effective customer management and ensuring that party-related operations function smoothly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the party reference data directory in the customer management system. It contains all necessary fields needed to perform the update operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource was updated.
